cards.name: Summer Ministry
cards.description: Church youth groups stay for weeklong mission trips and help Madison County residents with home repairs. Camp life includes shared meals, chores, recreation, devotions and evening worship.

financial_aid.text: We do not charge a set fee per group or per camper and do not want cost to be a barrier for any group or person wanting to come experience Glory Ridge.

cards.review_notes: Confirm the physical drop-off address and weekly departure dates with the provider. The Spring 2026 newsletter lists arrivals May 31, June 7, June 14, June 28, July 5, July 12, July 19, July 26 and August 2; June 21 is Homecoming Week. Sessions are omitted because departure dates are not stated, and no dates were projected from the weeklong description.
